name: UNEP Publications

download.notes: The Documents entity has a deferred 'files' navigation property. Expand it ($expand=files) to obtain the file/download URLs (typically external PDFs hosted by each MEA secretariat), then fetch directly.

methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UNEP's MEA document corpus is exposed through InforMEA, which provides a genuine REST API (OData v2) at http://odata.informea.org/informea.svc. The Documents collection holds ~44,616 documents. This is a real API family, not HTML scraping. A parallel Drupal REST API (SwaggerHub: eaudeweb-drupal/InforMEA-D8-API) and the browsable server-rendered listing at www.informea.org/en/documents (85k+ items) also exist as fallbacks.

## Search
Use OData query options against /Documents. Full-text-ish filtering via $filter=substringof('{query}',title). Browse via $top/$skip paging. The service exposes eight collections (Treaties, Meetings, Decisions, Contacts, National reports/action plans, Sites, Documents).

## Filters
Declared filters map to OData $filter: treaty (e.g. treaty eq 'basel') and published date ranges (ge/le datetime). Other navigation properties (types, keywords, authors) can be filtered/expanded.

## Download
The 'files' navigation property is deferred; expand it ($expand=files) to get download URLs, which are typically direct PDFs hosted by the individual MEA secretariats. Fetch directly.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Records are richly modeled: title, description, authors, types, treaties, keywords, identifiers, tags, files. Most are deferred, so one enrichment call per record with $expand returns full metadata.

## Limitations
HONEST: The base service runs over plain HTTP (odata.informea.org) and most content fields are deferred, requiring an $expand or a second call per record. Dates are OData /Date(ms)/ epoch format needing parsing. Terms of service ask integrators to include usage-tracking. The recjson-style shortcuts are not available; use OData query syntax.
probeNotes: www.informea.org/api documents both OData (odata.informea.org) and Drupal REST (SwaggerHub) APIs. Probed http://odata.informea.org/informea.svc/Documents?$top=2&$format=json -> valid JSON, 44,616 Documents, fields id/treaty/published/updated + deferred title/files/authors/types/treaties/keywords. Service metadata lists 8 collections. Confirmed rest-api.
